newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures finish higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures finish higher.

text.p: June 20 - U.S. debt futures finished higher after Sept T-bonds set new four-mos highs at 112-24/32. Resistance is at the six-mos high of 113-09/32. Rally was fueled by hedge fund buying, short-covering ahead of options expiration. U.S. May Fed budget deficit was at $48.5 bln, down 8.6 pct from May 1996. ((Chicago Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750))
